description: Set the organization's white-label email branding: display name (used as the From name and CAN-SPAM advertiser identity), brand color (#hex), default intro text, business_address (CAN-SPAM physical address — required before a campaign can be activated), and reply_to_email. Requires a Pro plan. (Logo upload is app-only — not available over MCP.)

business_address.description: Physical mailing address of the advertiser (CAN-SPAM).

display_name.description: The lender/brand name shown as the email sender and advertiser.

intro_text.description: Default intro paragraph for campaign emails.

logo_background_color.description: Solid backdrop behind the logo in the email header, as a 6-digit #hex (e.g. #0d1b2a). Useful when the logo is white. Omit or null for the white default.

reply_to_email.description: Optional Reply-To address for campaign emails.

name: set_email_branding

outputSchema.description: The organization's email branding after the update, wrapped in a `branding` envelope.

business_address.description: CAN-SPAM physical address. Required before a campaign can be activated or sent.

display_name.description: From-name and CAN-SPAM advertiser identity. Required before a campaign can be activated.

intro_text.description: Default intro paragraph for campaign emails.
